[[File:Stephen Michael portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Stephen Michael.]]
'''Stephen Michael''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 115 from Monroe, Ga. The slot is listed as Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />
